summary: PHILEON Layer 2 (Fulfillment Operations) fully validated. Ran 30 unit tests (fake DB) + 30 E2E tests hitting the live public backend via admin JWT + Playwright UI tests against /admin/fulfillment. All 60 backend tests pass. Historical order PHI-20260901-4CBC5C confirmed untouched (CAD, 2265000 cents, paid) and correctly appears in needs_review queue. Every integrity gate, state-machine transition, hold/release flow, tracking-URL helper, tracking-number sanitizer, double-shipment noop and correct-shipment audit trail behave to spec. Frontend queue page renders, all 6 tabs + search + detail card + audit trail + integrity pills + signature/insurance display work. Unauth guard redirects to /admin/login. /admin/shipments backwards-compat preserved.
critical_code_review_comments: admin_orders.py imports `db` at module load (`_get_db_and_verify()` called at import). This is fine because monkeypatching in tests replaces module.db, but it does create a tight coupling to server.py import order — worth documenting.

In mark-shipped the `email_sent` return depends on send_shipment_email returning {status: 'sent'}; if Resend is misconfigured the endpoint silently reports email_sent=false with no operator-visible signal. Consider surfacing send errors in the audit `extra` payload.
The `list_orders` merge of two $or clauses under $and works, but the trailing `**filt` splat could accidentally re-introduce popped keys if $or grows a sibling — currently safe, but fragile pattern.
test_credentials: Admin JWT minted via `python -c "from server import create_token; print(create_token('admin'))"` from /app/backend; used as Bearer for backend and localStorage.phileon_admin_token for frontend.
seed_data_creation: Test-only synthetic orders inserted directly into MongoDB with `PHI-TEST-*` prefix (order_number based on HHMMSSµs). Cleaned up in finally-blocks (delete_one on orders_v2 + delete_many on fulfillment_audit). No Stripe sessions, no real emails, no label purchases. Historical order PHI-20260901-4CBC5C never mutated.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Layer 2 fulfillment operations green. When testing Layer 3+, reuse test_admin_fulfillment_e2e.py as a regression suite — it exercises every /api/admin/orders route including the historical order in read-only mode. Admin JWT pattern: mint via server.create_token('admin'); set localStorage.phileon_admin_token for Playwright. Seed pattern: direct Motor insert with `PHI-TEST-<timestamp>` prefix + finally-cleanup avoids Stripe/email side effects.
